engine.description: Collect target-scoped URLs from historical sources and crawling, then report endpoint findings.

httpx.description: Probe collected URLs using httpx and report verified endpoint metadata.
httpx.name: HTTPX

rate-limit.description: Maximum httpx requests per second mapped to -rate-limit.

request-timeout.description: Per-request timeout in seconds mapped to -timeout.

retries.description: Number of httpx retries mapped to -retries.

threads.description: Number of concurrent httpx workers mapped to -threads.

timeout.description: Runtime timeout in seconds for the httpx process.

katana.description: Crawl Server-materialized URL seeds using Katana.
katana.name: Katana

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent Katana fetcher workers mapped to -c.

delay.description: Delay between Katana requests in seconds mapped to -rd.

depth.description: Maximum Katana crawl depth mapped to -d.

rate-limit.description: Maximum Katana requests per second mapped to -rl.

request-timeout.description: Per-request timeout in seconds mapped to -timeout.

retries.description: Number of Katana retries mapped to -retry.

timeout.description: Runtime timeout in seconds for the Katana process.

uro.description: Filter collected URLs using Uro before optional verification.
uro.name: Uro

blacklist.description: File extensions excluded by Uro and mapped to -b.

filters.description: Uro filters mapped to -f; allowed values control parameters, extensions, content URLs, and trailing slashes.

timeout.description: Runtime timeout in seconds for the Uro process.

whitelist.description: File extensions retained by Uro and mapped to -w.

waymore.description: Collect historical URLs for domain Targets using Waymore.
waymore.name: Waymore

timeout.description: Runtime timeout in seconds for the Waymore process.
